This stable release rolls up dev pre-release **v2.23-dev** since the previous stable (v2.22). It fixes Program Data import duplicating requirements on re-import, and makes program-data export/import round-trip the full tiered-program structure.

## Program Data import now replaces instead of duplicating

Re-importing an edited **Program Data** export used to **duplicate** existing requirements. For example: export a program's Theatre requirements, copy the rows, change them to Country level with new quantities, and re-import — the Country rows were added, but the original Theatre rows were duplicated. This is now fixed.

- **Import replaces, it does not merge.** For every program named in the file, its existing requirements are **deleted and re-created from the file** — so re-importing an edited export never duplicates rows. Programs that aren't in the file are left completely untouched. The whole import runs in a single transaction, so a failure can't leave a program half-updated.
- **A clear warning before anything is overwritten.** When you already have data, the import preview shows an amber banner naming the programs that will be replaced and asks you to tick a confirmation box before the **Import** button becomes active.

## Export/import round-trips the full program structure

Previously an export dropped some tiered-program settings, so exporting and re-importing a program could silently revert it. Export now also carries:

- **Deployment Handling** — the program-level "Deployment requirement handling" mode (Flat / Per achieved specialisation / Per tier, per achieved specialisation).
- **Tier Order** and **Tier Specialisations Required** — for each tier of a tiered program.
- **Tier-definition rows** — tiers that have no requirement rows of their own (common in "Per achieved specialisation" mode) are exported as blank rows so they survive a round-trip instead of vanishing.

A program exported and re-imported unchanged is now restored **exactly** — same requirement count, same tiers, same deployment mode, no duplicates. The downloadable import template also gains the new columns (Tier, Purpose, Deployment Handling, Tier Order, Tier Specialisations Required) and an example tier row.

## Not changed

- The other admin imports — **Training Data, Product Types, Specialisations, Region Data** — already merge safely against a unique key and can't create duplicates, so they're unchanged. **Student import is unchanged.**
- No database migration.

No action needed after updating.
